findings.body: If approval is revoked and that story-state change reaches the task checkout, both the canonical and checkout approvals are absent. This condition then falls through, and both subsequent hash checks are skipped because `approved` is false. `forge work` can consequently commit its status and start a full-access worker on the changed, unapproved brief. Refuse missing canonical approval unconditionally, as `src/forge/task.py:137–139` already does. Extend the approval test to remove the checkout's approval too; its current case preserves that old copy.
findings.title: Not done: 8. Refuse missing approval even when the checkout's copy is gone
